deviations.reason: Shape (a) never applied: repo-wide grep confirms zero skill-researcher-hard/skill-planner-hard/skill-implementer-hard references exist anywhere in the source tree (apparently removed by an earlier, unrelated task). A fourth rewrite shape was needed instead in several files -- retargeting a claim about WHICH component now owns a piece of functionality (Stage 5a/5c validation and continuation-loop init, the split inline-commit shape) to its actual current owner, skill-orchestrate, since these responsibilities moved rather than simply having their skill renamed.

notes: Several files (system-overview.md, skill-lifecycle.md, multi-task-operations.md, task-lock.md, checkpoint-execution.md) required substantive rewrites beyond a mechanical name swap, since whole sections' premises (a /research-/plan-/implement-command-plus-skill-layer architecture) are now stale, not merely the specific skill names. Rewrites preserve each document's teaching content while retargeting claims to the current skill-orchestrate-direct-agent-dispatch architecture. context-protective-lead.md's compliance-audit table used a documented in-file precedent (retaining a retired skill's row, annotated historical) for the skill-orchestrator row; the three deleted skills' rows were collapsed into one non-literal-name row instead of following that precedent verbatim, since the precedent's literal name still matched the task's own zero-hit grep target.
